core_principle: STRICTLY LOCAL, OFFLINE-CAPABLE, SELF-CONTAINED, END-TO-END ENERGY MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
system_goals: Build an offline-first microgrid Energy Management System (EMS) for remote/off-grid stations.
Decouple operational forecasting engines from energy optimization and dispatch logic via stable contracts.
Implement a receding-horizon Model Predictive Control (MPC) dispatch loop with a Digital Twin simulator.
Provide transparent local CLI tools for forecasting, optimization, simulation, and evaluation.
Enforce 100% local data and execution isolation with zero cloud or network dependencies.

architecture_layers.layer_1_data: Local files (CSV, Parquet, NetCDF, JSON) managed by LocalWeatherProvider and LocalDataProvider.
architecture_layers.layer_2_forecasting: ForecastEngine implementations (HistGBDT, Chronos, TimesFM, Persistence) outputting versioned ForecastBundle.
architecture_layers.layer_4_simulation: Digital Twin Simulator stepping actual environmental state against DispatchPlan in closed-loop MPC.
architecture_layers.layer_5_evaluation: Decoupled ForecastMetrics and EnergyManagementMetrics evaluation engine.

validated_vs_unvalidated.research_validated: Phase C-1/C-2 GBDT feature extractability for H7-H12 daytime solar transmission and irradiance.
validated_vs_unvalidated.operational_prototype: Operational H1-H24 solar, wind, and demand forecasting modules (marked as PROTOTYPE / UNVALIDATED OPERATIONAL COMPONENTS).

first_milestone: Milestone D1 — Local System Foundation, Interfaces, Schemas, & Offline Test Harness.
